rules.name: Velocity Spike (Inbound Degree)
rules.description: Triggers when an account receives more than the threshold of inbound UPI transfers in a 24-hour period.

rules.name: Short Holding Time Ratio
rules.description: Triggers when more than the threshold of received funds are transferred out of the account within 30 minutes.

rules.name: Suspicious Component Connection
rules.description: Triggers when a node has direct connection (shared device/IP/phone) to previously blocked/flagged fraud nodes.

rules.name: High-Value Shell Transfer
rules.description: Triggers on a transfer exceeding threshold from/to newly registered corporate shell entities.

rules.name: Circular Money Flow
rules.description: Triggers when an account participates in a closed money flow loop of connected accounts.

rules.name: Dormant Account Activation
rules.description: Triggers when a previously inactive/dormant account receives significant transaction volume within 24 hours.
